title: Le Marin
text:
This series reinterprets the myth of Le Marin as a contemporary symbol of masculinity, balancing sensuality, strength, and introspection. Inspired by nautical archetypes and the marinière, the sailor is presented as a modern figure caught between tradition and subtle disruption.

Through a cinematic black-and-white aesthetic, the images explore a softer reading of masculinity, combining vulnerability and confidence, while evoking a quiet, dramatic atmosphere influenced by maritime and 1980s visual references.

The project draws inspiration from Jean Paul Gaultier’s Le Male universe and its iconic sailor imagery, where masculinity is redefined through sensuality and irony.

Building on this legacy, the editorial reimagines the sailor within a contemporary context, shifting him from a traditional archetype into a fluid symbol of identity, freedom, and emotional depth. The sea becomes a metaphor for transformation, linking past and present through a timeless visual language.
